authority.membership: opaque live actor-incarnation/group grant; duplicate join does not mint another
authority.publisher: authenticated executing turn plus same-group live grant
authority.subscriber: authenticated actor or delegated exact-group target admission

delivery.topology: one attempt per eligible (subscription,target incarnation); overlap not deduplicated
delivery.admission: atomic all-recipient reserve before u64 topic sequence
delivery.order: one per-topic admission sequence; no cross-topic ordering
delivery.unsubscribe: cancel queued, fence new starts, wait for inflight

cases.name: atomic reliable admission does not skip sequence on full recipient
scoped publish requires exact live publisher grant
overlapping group scoped edges are independent
unsubscribe cancels pending and fences starts
get_done waits for an in-flight handler
leave and rejoin cannot resurrect old grant
duplicate subscribe is one edge and capacity conflict rejected
group leave preserves other group's deliveries
